title: My Tasks
description: The office's tasks on the My Tasks screen, per role (decision 0041). A role listed here gets My Tasks; its people can add their own tasks too. Format version 1.

version.description: Release number of this file's content. Bump it when tasks change.

roles.description: Role id (from roles.json) → the office's tasks for that role, in display order. An empty list still turns on My Tasks.

priority.description: Set by the office; people can't change it. Shown in words with a color: high red, medium amber, low green.

id.description: Stable id the phone keeps progress under. Never changes and is never reused.

title.description: Short name shown on the screen and the picture. Can be changed; the id keeps the progress.

notes.description: Optional starting notes. They fill the task's Notes box on the phone, which the person can edit or delete.

retired.description: Taken off the screen. What people typed for it stays on their phones.
